title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Access Control Policy (Nimbus Labs) > Access reviews

Access reviews run every quarter. Managers confirm or remove each person's access, and the Engineering Manager signs off the review.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Results

The auditor noted two exceptions during the period:

One quarterly access review was completed 6 days after the due date in Q1 2026.One terminated contractor retained read-only access to a staging tool for 2 days after their contract ended.

Both exceptions were remediated and closed before the report was issued. No exceptions related to encryption, backups or incident response.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Vendor Management Policy > Ongoing review

Tier 1 vendors are reviewed once a year. Tier 2 vendors are reviewed every two years. Any vendor that suffers a security incident is reviewed immediately.
